### Our Motor Rewinding & Electrical Repair Services

6. **Transformer Rewinding** - Industrial transformer coil winding, primary and secondary winding replacement, insulation paper testing, and electrical troubleshooting.

### Our 5-Step Motor Rewinding Process

Every motor handled at the Vapi workshop passes through a strict electrical and mechanical standard to ensure long-term industrial reliability.

1. **Inspection** - Megger insulation test, surge test, bearing check, and root cause fault identification.
2. **Dismantling** - Careful core disassembly, coil burnout data logging, and slot cleaning.
3. **Rewinding** - Precision coil winding using super-enameled copper wire & Class F/H insulation.
4. **Varnishing** - Deep varnish impregnation and oven baking to eliminate moisture and vibration.
5. **Testing** - No-load current testing, resistance balance, and final quality sign-off.

Homepage workflow steps as numbered cards:
- 01 Inspect - Motor condition & electrical diagnosis
- 02 Dismantle - Careful disassembly and preparation
- 03 Rewind - Precision copper coil winding
- 04 Varnish - Insulation treatment and baking
- 05 Test - Final electrical testing

### Homepage FAQ Block (6 Questions)

- **What types of motors do you rewind?** We rewind single-phase and 3-phase AC induction motors, DC motors, armatures, generator alternators, transformer coils, and industrial pump motors.
- **Do you handle AC and DC motors?** Yes, we provide complete rewinding, stator insulation, armature overhaul, commutator undercutting, and brush alignment for both AC and DC equipment.
- **How long does rewinding take?** Turnaround depends on the motor rating, core condition, copper requirements, and current workshop workload. We prioritize emergency factory breakdowns to minimize plant downtime.
- **How is rewinding cost calculated?** Cost is determined by motor horsepower/kW rating, frame size, weight of electrolytic copper wire, insulation grade (Class F or H), and any mechanical work such as bearing replacement. We inspect the motor and provide a clear quotation before beginning work.
- **Do you provide motor testing?** Yes. Every repaired motor undergoes pre-delivery testing including Megger insulation resistance testing, winding resistance balance, and no-load current checks.
- **Where is the workshop located?** Shop No. 28 & 29, Express House, Near C.N.G. Gujarat Gas Station, N.H. 48, GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat 396195, with direct national highway access for trucks and transport.

### Frequently Asked Questions

- **What motor rewinding and repair services do you provide in Vapi?** We rewind and repair AC single-phase and 3-phase induction motors, DC motors, industrial generators and alternators, transformers, and welding machines. We also handle pump motor rewinding, submersible pump repair, blower motor winding, and rotor balancing from our workshop in GIDC Vapi.
- **How do I know if my electric motor needs rewinding?** Common warning signs are abnormal overheating, circuit breakers or overload relays tripping, a burnt or smoky smell from the motor, low insulation resistance (failed Megger test), and unsteady speed or phase current imbalance. If you notice any of these, bring the motor to our workshop and we will run a winding and insulation test to confirm whether it needs rewinding or a simpler repair.
- **Why does my motor keep burning out even after rewinding?** A motor that fails repeatedly is usually caused by an external problem rather than the winding itself. Common causes include unbalanced supply voltage, overloading, single phasing, low voltage, moisture ingress, and blocked cooling. When we take in a motor we inspect the failure cause first, because rewinding without correcting the underlying fault will only burn the next winding too.
- **How much does motor rewinding cost?** Cost depends mainly on the motor's HP/kW rating and frame size, the copper quantity, the insulation class used, and whether additional mechanical work such as shaft or bearing repair is required. There is no fixed price, so we inspect the motor and give you an estimate and an honest comparison with replacement cost before starting work.
- **Should I get my motor rewound or replace it with a new one?** For large industrial motors and non-standard units that are hard to source, rewinding is usually far more economical than buying new. For small, standard motors where a replacement is easily available and inexpensive, replacement may make more sense. After inspection we advise you honestly on which option gives better value.
- **How long does motor rewinding take?** Turnaround depends on the motor size, winding complexity, core condition, and our current workload. We prioritize emergency breakdowns for manufacturing plants in Vapi GIDC and nearby industrial belts to reduce downtime. Call us with your motor details and we will give you a realistic timeline.
- **What copper wire and insulation do you use for rewinding?** We use 100% super-enameled electrolytic grade copper wire with high-temperature Class F / Class H insulating papers and varnishes, matched to the motor's operating conditions so the rewind lasts under industrial heat and load.
- **Do you rewind AC induction motors?** Yes. We rewind and overhaul single-phase and 3-phase AC induction motors, including squirrel cage and slip ring types, with proper phase-to-phase insulation, slot insulation, and balanced winding for standard and custom industrial motors across Vapi GIDC.
- **Do you handle DC motor winding and repair?** Yes. We carry out DC motor armature rewinding, field coil repair, commutator turning, mica undercutting, and brush and brush-housing servicing for variable-speed industrial drives, cranes, and machine tools.
- **Can you repair pump, submersible, and blower motors?** Yes. We rewind centrifugal and chemical pump motors, borewell and dewatering submersible motor windings, and ID/FD fan, exhaust, and centrifugal blower motors, including insulation testing and rotor balancing where needed.
- **Do you repair generators and alternators?** Yes. We rewind and service industrial generators and alternators, including main stators, exciter rotors, field windings, and faulty diode assemblies, followed by electrical testing before delivery.
- **Do you provide transformer rewinding?** Yes. We rewind control transformers, step-down transformers, and industrial welding transformers using quality copper wire and proper dielectric insulation, with insulation testing after completion.
- **Where is your workshop located and which areas do you serve?** Our workshop is at Shop No. 28 & 29, Express House, Near C.N.G. Gujarat Gas Station, N.H. 48, GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat 396195, with direct highway access for motor loading and unloading. We serve plants across GIDC Vapi and nearby industrial corridors including Silvassa, Daman, Valsad, Pardi, Bhilad, and Sarigam GIDC.
- **How can I contact you for a motor repair quote?** Call us on +91 98252 72547 or message us on WhatsApp at the same number. Share the motor's nameplate details and the fault you are seeing, and we will guide you on the likely repair and how to bring the motor to our workshop.
- **What testing do you perform before and after rewinding a motor?** Before rewinding we run a 1000V Megger insulation resistance test, phase resistance balance check using a digital micro-ohm meter, and a visual core-and-slot inspection. After rewinding and varnishing we repeat the Megger test, verify winding resistance balance across all phases, perform a no-load run test, and check 3-phase current balance. Where rotor vibration is suspected, we also carry out dynamic balancing.
- **My motor is making loud noise and vibrating - what could be wrong?** Loud noise and vibration most often indicate worn or seized bearings, rotor unbalance, shaft misalignment, a broken cooling fan rubbing against the end cover, or loose motor mountings. Bearing noise is typically a constant rumble or high-pitched whine, while rotor unbalance produces vibration that increases with speed. Bring the motor in and we will inspect the bearings, check shaft run-out, and carry out dynamic rotor balancing if needed - this usually prevents a future winding burnout.
- **Do you do on-site diagnosis or do I have to bring the motor to your workshop?** Most rewinding, bearing replacement, and testing work is done at our GIDC Vapi workshop because rewinding, varnish baking, and rotor balancing require dedicated bench tools, ovens, and test equipment that cannot be taken on site. For initial on-site checks you can call us on +91 98252 72547 and we will guide you on basic tripping or supply-side issues and help arrange bringing the motor in if a workshop job is needed.
- **What is the difference between Class F and Class H insulation in motor rewinding?** Insulation class defines the maximum allowable operating temperature of the winding. Class F insulation is rated for 155 degrees C and Class H for 180 degrees C at the hottest spot. Class H is used for motors that run under continuous heavy load, operate in hot or poorly ventilated areas, or are located close to furnaces and boilers. We select the class based on the motor's original nameplate and its actual working environment so the rewound winding lasts under the real heat and load conditions it will see in your plant.
- **How do I know if my motor bearings need replacement?** Warning signs of failing bearings are a steady grinding or rumbling noise that gets louder with speed, increased motor body temperature near the end covers, visible play when you rock the shaft by hand, or vibration that is strongest at the bearing housings. If you ignore worn bearings, the rotor will start rubbing against the stator core and cause a costly winding burnout. We replace bearings with proper C3-clearance industrial grade bearings using a hydraulic press so the fit is correct and the bearing life is maximized.
- **What is rotor dynamic balancing and when is it required?** Dynamic balancing corrects uneven weight distribution in a spinning rotor so it rotates without heavy vibration. It is required when you feel strong motor vibration, after a bent or machined shaft, whenever bearings have failed catastrophically, or after rewinding a high-speed or large motor. Unbalanced rotors destroy bearings in weeks and eventually crack the motor end shields and machine mountings. We balance rotors in two planes and correct unbalance by adding or removing weight so the motor runs smooth after installation.
- **How does varnishing and baking help after rewinding?** After the new coils are placed in the slots, the winding is vacuum-impregnated or dipped in high-grade electrical varnish and then oven-baked at a controlled temperature. This locks every conductor firmly in place, prevents coil movement and vibration that would wear the enamel, fills air gaps that can cause corona and partial discharge, improves heat transfer out of the winding, and adds a second layer of moisture and chemical protection. Skipping proper varnishing is the most common reason a freshly rewound motor fails within a few months.
- **My 3-phase motor trips on overload - should I increase the relay setting?** No - never increase the overload relay setting above the motor nameplate current without first finding the cause. Frequent tripping tells you the motor is drawing more current than it should, and the most common reasons are: actual mechanical overload on the machine, low or unbalanced supply voltage, a phase that is partially open (single phasing), shorted turns inside the winding, or a mechanically seized load. Bypassing the protection will burn the winding and turn a small problem into a full rewinding job.
- **What causes single phasing in a 3-phase motor and how serious is it?** Single phasing happens when one of the three supply lines is lost because of a blown fuse, a loose connection, a faulty contactor pole, or a broken cable. A 3-phase induction motor running on two phases will draw very high current in the remaining two windings and overheat rapidly, usually burning the winding within minutes if the protection does not trip. Always switch off the motor immediately and check all three supply phases, the fuses, the contactor, and the cable joints before attempting to restart.
- **My submersible pump motor trips after running for some time - why?** In submersible motors, delayed tripping is usually caused by moisture seeping into the winding through a damaged cable joint or a worn mechanical seal, by silt and sand locking the impeller, or by an internal winding fault whose resistance drops as the winding gets hot. Low borewell water level causing the motor to run dry is another very common cause. We test the stator with a Megger to confirm ground leakage, rewind the motor with moisture-resistant Class F/H insulation, and advise on seal and cable replacement so the same problem does not repeat.
- **Do you repair welding machines and welding transformers?** Yes. We repair ARC, MIG, and TIG welding machines, including the heavy-duty step-down welding transformers used in fabrication shops across Vapi GIDC. Common jobs are rewinding burnt primary and secondary coils, replacing burnt copper strips and mica separators, fixing thermal overload trips, and repairing power-stage and control-board issues. After repair we run a load test and an arc-strike test along with a Megger insulation check so the welder is safe to use.
- **What information should I have ready when calling for a repair estimate?** To give you a realistic estimate over the phone or WhatsApp, please share the motor's nameplate details: manufacturer, HP or kW rating, voltage, number of phases, RPM or speed, frame size if visible, and insulation class. Also tell us the exact fault you are seeing (trips immediately, runs hot, makes noise, does not start, etc.) and roughly how old the motor is and where it is installed. Photos of the nameplate and the general condition of the motor on WhatsApp help us a lot.
- **Can a rewound motor be as good and efficient as a brand new motor?** Yes, if the rewinding is done correctly using the original winding data, genuine electrolytic-grade copper wire, proper slot and phase insulation, and correct impregnation and curing. A bad rewind that reduces the copper cross-section or skips proper insulation and varnishing does hurt efficiency and life. That is why we strictly follow the original winding turns and wire gauge, use the same or better insulation class than the original, and test the motor electrically after rewinding so the results match or exceed the original factory specs.
- **What is a Megger test and what reading tells me my winding is bad?** A Megger is an insulation resistance tester that applies a high DC voltage (usually 500V or 1000V) between the winding conductors and the motor frame to measure leakage through the insulation. As a very rough guide, a healthy industrial motor should show several megaohms and the reading should be stable. A reading below 1 megaohm on a 400V class motor is a warning, and a reading near zero or that keeps dropping as the test runs almost always means moisture ingress or burnt insulation and the winding should not be energized until repaired.
- **How important is it to repair the shaft or bearing housing on an old motor?** It is extremely important. A worn rotor shaft journal or a loose end-cover bearing housing will make even a brand new bearing run eccentric, causing heavy vibration and destroying the bearing within weeks. We always check shaft run-out with a dial gauge, inspect housing bores for ovality, and either machine or sleeve worn shafts and housings back to standard tolerances before reassembly. Skipping these mechanical checks is the single most common reason a good rewinding job fails prematurely.
- **Do you handle emergency breakdown jobs for factories in GIDC Vapi?** Yes - emergency breakdowns for manufacturing plants, chemical units, paper mills, and packaging lines in GIDC Vapi and nearby industrial belts are given priority scheduling so your downtime stays as short as possible. Call +91 98252 72547 as soon as the breakdown happens, tell us the motor rating and which machine is down, and we will give you the fastest realistic turnaround for the repair. Whenever workload allows, we fast-track urgent jobs ahead of routine work.

## Motor Rewinding Services in Vapi

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/services/motor-rewinding.html

Precision coil rewinding, stator reconstruction, Class F/H insulation, and thorough load testing for industrial electric motors.

### Professional Electric Motor Rewinding in Vapi GIDC

When an electric motor experiences electrical insulation failure, inter-turn short circuits, or ground faults, rewinding restores the motor back to full factory specifications. At Hindustan Electricals Winding Works, we provide precision motor rewinding services for industrial plants, textile mills, chemical manufacturing units, and engineering workshops across Vapi, Silvassa, Daman, and Valsad.

### When Does a Motor Need Rewinding?

- **Burnt Smell & Discoloration** - Stator insulation has deteriorated due to severe overheating.
- **Breaker Tripping on Start** - Immediate circuit breaker or thermal overload trip indicating a ground or short circuit fault.
- **Low Megger Reading** - Insulation resistance below recommended threshold (typically below 1 megaohm).
- **Phase Imbalance** - Unequal current draw between phases leading to sluggish rotation and excess vibration.

### Our Motor Rewinding Workflow

We adhere to a methodical reconstruction workflow that prevents premature failure and maintains core magnetic permeability:

1. **Initial Diagnosis** - Surge testing, winding resistance measurement, and visual core inspection.
2. **Controlled Stripping** - Recording original winding data (wire gauge, slot turns, span, and connections) followed by careful coil removal without warping stator laminations.
3. **Slot Preparation** - Cleaning core slots and inserting Class F/H Nomex/Mylar composite insulation liners.
4. **Precision Coil Insertion** - Inserting new coils wound with 100% electrolytic super-enameled copper wire.
5. **Varnishing & Baking** - Vacuum/dip varnish impregnation followed by oven baking for moisture-proof sealing.
6. **Quality Testing** - High potential insulation test, phase resistance balance check, and no-load spin test.

### Types of Motors Handled

Our workshop is equipped to rewind all major electric motor categories:

- AC 3-Phase Induction Motors
- Single-Phase Capacitor Motors
- Slip Ring / Wound Rotor Motors
- DC Armatures & Field Coils
- Commercial Submersible Pumps
- Industrial Exhaust & Blower Motors

Quote: Need a Motor Rewinding Quote in Vapi? Contact us with your motor HP rating, make, and problem. We provide rapid diagnostic turnaround. Call: +91 98252 72547 / WhatsApp Quote.

Emergency note: Our workshop team is on standby for urgent motor rewinding requirements across Vapi GIDC.

## AC Motor Winding & Rewinding Services in Vapi

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/services/ac-motor-winding.html

Specialized single-phase and 3-phase AC induction motor coil winding, phase balance testing, and Class F/H insulation overhaul.

### Precision AC Induction Motor Winding in Vapi GIDC

AC induction motors form the backbone of industrial machinery in manufacturing, chemical, textile, and packaging facilities throughout Vapi GIDC. When an AC motor experiences stator burnout, single phasing, or bearing seizure, Hindustan Electricals Winding Works provides end-to-end rewinding and testing.

### AC Motor Capabilities

- **3-Phase Squirrel Cage Motors** - Standard industrial pumps, blowers, compressors, and conveyors, from small HP units to heavy industrial kW ratings.
- **Slip Ring (Wound Rotor) Motors** - Crane, hoist, and heavy starting torque machinery rewinding.
- **Single-Phase Capacitor Start/Run Motors** - Utility pumps, exhaust units, and workshop equipment.
- **Multi-Speed / Dual-Speed Motors** - Dahlander winding and dual separate winding configurations.

### Our AC Rewinding Process

AC motor winding requires exact symmetry in coil resistance and inductance across all three phases (R-Y-B) to avoid negative phase sequence heating:

1. **Core Preparation** - Removing old burnt copper coils without stretching or damaging the silicon steel stator teeth.
2. **Coil Forming** - Winding precise turn counts with dual-coated super-enameled electrolytic copper wire.
3. **Phase Separation** - Installing Nomex phase separator papers to insulate adjacent phase coils in shared slots.
4. **Lacing & Tying** - Tightly tying stator coil overhangs with glass-fiber cord to resist electromagnetic starting shock.
5. **Thermal Varnish Impregnation** - Deep dipping and controlled oven curing.
6. **Electrical Bench Testing** - Digital micro-ohm phase resistance balance, 1000V Megger insulation resistance, and 3-phase no-load current measurement.

## DC Motor Winding & Repair Services in Vapi

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/services/dc-motor-winding.html

Armature rewinding, field coil overhaul, commutator turning, mica undercutting, and dynamic testing in Vapi GIDC.

### Industrial DC Motor Armature & Field Coil Rewinding

DC motors are commonly deployed in heavy industrial applications requiring precise variable speed, high starting torque, or constant torque characteristics - such as extruders, printing machinery, metal rolling mills, and overhead cranes. Hindustan Electricals Winding Works repairs and rewinds both the rotating armature and stationary field poles of DC motors.

### Common DC Motor Problems We Resolve

- **Severe Commutator Sparking** - Worn carbon brushes, high mica segments, or short-circuited armature coils.
- **Armature Ground Faults** - Breakdown of slot insulation paper caused by conductive carbon dust buildup.
- **Burnt Field Coils** - Open circuit or short circuit in shunt/series field windings leading to motor runaway or failure to start.
- **Commutator Grooving & Pitting** - Uneven electrical wear across segments requiring precision lathe skimming and mica undercutting.

### Our DC Motor Overhaul Process

DC motor repair demands exacting mechanical and electrical precision:

1. **Growler Testing** - Testing the armature core on an electromagnetic growler with a feeler blade to pinpoint shorted turns.
2. **Data Recording & Stripping** - Recording the lap or wave winding scheme, slot pitch, equalizer connections, and commutator riser pitch.
3. **Armature Coil Insertion & Banding** - Inserting coils, soldering risers with high-temperature solder, and glass-tape banding the end turns to withstand centrifugal forces.
4. **Commutator Machining** - Precision turning on a lathe, segment chamfering, and mica undercutting.
5. **Field Coils & Interpole Overhaul** - Checking resistance and insulating with high-dielectric varnish.
6. **Brush Alignment & Bedding** - Setting neutral axis position and bedding carbon brushes for spark-free commutation.

Quote: Request a DC Motor Repair Quote. Contact the workshop directly. We provide rapid diagnostic turnaround for industrial plants in Vapi. Call: +91 98252 72547 / WhatsApp Quote.

## Electric Motor Repair Services in Vapi

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/services/electric-motor-repair.html

Comprehensive mechanical and electrical repair: bearing replacement, shaft correction, vibration diagnosis, and electrical overhaul in Vapi GIDC.

### Mechanical & Electrical Motor Overhaul in Vapi GIDC

Not every failing motor requires a full rewind. Often, mechanical issues such as worn bearings, shaft misalignment, broken cooling fans, or loose terminal blocks cause severe overheating, noise, or electrical tripping. At Hindustan Electricals Winding Works, we provide complete diagnostic motor repair services to fix the root cause and avoid repeat failures.

### Key Mechanical & Electrical Repair Capabilities

- **Precision Bearing Replacement:** Installing premium grade C3 clearance bearings with proper hydraulic press fitment.
- **Rotor Dynamic Balancing:** Eliminating unbalance vibrations to extend bearing life and safeguard machine mountings.
- **Shaft & Housing Sleeving:** Machining worn rotor shafts and end-cover bearing housings back to standard tolerances.
- **Terminal Block & Lead Wire Replacement:** Upgrading brittle, charred terminal connections with heavy-duty heat-resistant leads.

### Common Motor Symptoms & Solutions

- **Excessive Vibration & Grinding Noise:** Caused by spalled bearing raceways, lack of lubrication, or mechanical misalignment. We dismantle, inspect housing bores, and install new precision bearings.
- **Rapid Overheating Under Normal Load:** Often triggered by clogged ventilation shrouds, defective cooling impellers, or rotor bar cracks. We clean air passages and check rotor cage continuity.
- **Frequent Terminal Box Sparks or Burnout:** Loose crimp lugs or moisture ingress lead to localized resistance and flashovers. We install new porcelain/Bakelite terminal blocks with silicone sealing.

## Rotor Dynamic Balancing & Vibration Repair in Vapi

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/services/rotor-balancing.html

Precision dynamic balancing for motor rotors, armatures, and fan assemblies to cut vibration, bearing wear, and overheating.

### Dynamic Rotor Balancing Service in Vapi

A motor can be rewound perfectly and still fail early if its rotor runs out of balance. Excessive vibration from an unbalanced rotor accelerates bearing wear, damages end-shields, causes shaft bending, and raises winding temperature. During motor overhauls and after rewinding, Hindustan Electricals Winding Works performs dynamic balancing of rotors and armatures so rebuilt motors run smooth, quiet, and long in demanding industrial duty.

### Balancing & Vibration Services Provided

- **Dynamic Rotor Balancing** - Two-plane correction of motor rotors, squirrel-cage rotors, and wound armatures.
- **Fan & Pulley Balancing** - Balancing blower wheels, cooling fan assemblies, and motor-mounted pulleys.
- **Vibration Diagnosis** - Identifying whether vibration comes from unbalance, misalignment, or bad bearings.
- **Balanced Reassembly** - Correct keying, boring, and attitude checks so motors stay true at rated speed.

### Our Balancing Workflow

1. **Vibration Assessment** - Running the rotor and measuring shake, noise, and hot spots to confirm unbalance.
2. **Rotor Preparation** - Cleaning, inspecting the shaft for truth, and checking fan and keyway condition.
3. **Spin Balancing** - Rotating the assembly and locating the heavy spot in both correction planes.
4. **Weight Correction** - Adding or removing balance material precisely until runout is minimized.
5. **Reassembly Check** - Fitting bearings and end-shields, then verifying smooth running at operating speed.

Quote: Your Motor Vibrating Badly? Unbalanced motors fail quickly. Call for rotor balancing and vibration diagnosis at the Vapi workshop. Call: +91 98252 72547 / WhatsApp Quote.

## Terms and Conditions

Page URL: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/terms-and-conditions.html

Last updated: September 2026. Standard terms governing service engagement, repair estimates, and workshop operations.

### 1. General Agreement

These Terms and Conditions govern the provision of electric motor rewinding, AC/DC motor winding, alternator servicing, transformer repair, and mechanical overhaul services by Hindustan Electricals Winding Works ("the Workshop") to clients, commercial entities, and industrial plants ("the Customer").

By dispatching motors or electrical equipment to our facility or approving a service quotation via phone, WhatsApp, or in person, the Customer agrees to these operational terms.

### 2. Diagnostic Inspection & Quotations

- Preliminary estimates provided via phone, website, or WhatsApp are non-binding budgetary figures based on information provided by the Customer.
- Final quotations are issued following physical inspection, Megger insulation testing, and core disassembly at our workshop.
- In cases where dismantling reveals hidden mechanical defects (e.g. cracked rotor bars, bent shaft, damaged bearing housings), the Workshop will inform the Customer and obtain approval prior to executing additional machining or parts replacement.

### 3. Materials & Workmanship

- All motor rewinding is performed using high-grade electrolytic copper wire and Class F / Class H temperature insulation systems.
- Prior to delivery, rewound motors undergo electrical testing, including insulation resistance (Megger test), phase resistance balance check, and no-load spin testing.
- The Workshop is responsible for executing skilled craftsmanship in accordance with accepted industrial electrical engineering practices.

### 4. Equipment Collection, Storage & Logistics

- Transportation of heavy electric motors to and from our workshop in Express House, GIDC Vapi is the responsibility of the Customer unless specific logistics coordination is mutually agreed in advance.
- Customers are requested to arrange collection of repaired or inspected equipment within 30 days of notification of job completion.

### 5. Limitation of Liability

The Workshop's liability is strictly limited to the cost of rewinding and repair labor agreed upon for the specific motor or equipment. The Workshop shall not be held liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses, including lost factory production, plant downtime, or secondary equipment failure caused by power surges, phase loss, or improper electrical installation at the Customer's premises.

### 6. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes arising from services rendered shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Vapi / Valsad district, Gujarat.

### 7. Workshop Contact Information

- Hindustan Electricals Winding Works
- Shop No. 28 & 29, Express House, Near C.N.G. Gujarat Gas Station, N.H. 48, GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat 396195
- Phone: +91 98252 72547
- WhatsApp: +91 98252 72547

### Structured Data (JSON-LD) Published on the Site

- **Electrician (business entity):** name, url, telephone, priceRange, description, PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates, hasMap, areaServed list, sameAs WhatsApp, openingHoursSpecification (Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 20:00), and hasOfferCatalog with Service entries.
- **WebSite:** name, url, publisher reference to the business entity.
- **FAQPage:** six question and answer entries on the homepage matching the visible FAQ block.
- **Service:** per-page service markup on each dedicated service page.
- **BreadcrumbList:** navigation hierarchy on interior pages.
- **Person:** developer profile markup for Samir Shaikh.
- Entity IDs: https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/#business and https://hindustan-electricals-winding-works.vercel.app/#website
- Offer catalog services include Motor Rewinding, AC Motor Winding, DC Motor Winding and Electric Motor Repair, each with its canonical service URL and description.

### Offer Catalog Service Entries

- Motor Rewinding: complete electrical motor rewinding and restoration with super-enameled copper wire and Class F/H thermal insulation.
- AC Motor Winding: single-phase and 3-phase AC induction motor stator rewinding, coil replacement, and load testing.
- DC Motor Winding: DC motor armature rewinding, commutator undercutting, brush gear alignment, and field coil overhaul.
- Electric Motor Repair: diagnostic overhaul, precision bearing replacement, rotor shaft runout correction, and mechanical balancing.

### Site Architecture

- Static Vercel deployment with clean URLs; no framework runtime and no package manager build step.
- Pure semantic HTML5 with ARIA landmarks and a single h1 per page.
- Vanilla CSS3 (css/style.css, css/responsive.css) plus Tailwind CSS via Play CDN with a brand theme configuration (js/tailwind.config.js).
- Lightweight vanilla JavaScript (js/script.js) for mobile navigation, FAQ accordions, the sticky mobile CTA dock and form handling.
- Font Awesome and inline SVG icons; Google Fonts (Outfit / Inter).
- Embedded responsive Google Maps iframe for Express House, GIDC Vapi.
- Mobile sticky Call / WhatsApp dock below 768px viewport width.
- Security and caching headers configured in vercel.json.
- Developer redirect stub at /developer.html pointing to https://samir-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/.
